{"kind":"hv-full-content-r7","artifact":"verdict.md","sequence":10,"total":13,"artifactSha256":"8E36FE96DF037CAB1E56DFE2ACFBE22AB5764773E1B7B5C95C894334E118C9F9","content":"ome: Implement the shared selector and bind leakage/omission controls to actual discovered IDs before accepting either gate.

**N21 PASS** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, Generator mismatch/failure publication contract. Round 6: ADD-AC. Evidence: D1 now states that the callback writes a candidate before clock acceptance. One-host/both-host mismatch, malformed/missing record, write failure and interrupted retry leave accepted fixture/manifest unchanged, retain candidate evidence under receipts, return nonzero with blocked IDs and reject stale artifact reuse. D5 owns the real cases. Rationale: The acceptance/publication gap identified in round 6 is closed as a plan contract. N25 clarifies honest evidence when the native writer itself leaves no candidate file. Required outcome: Use mock-proven publication isolation and retained evidence; never move/delete an existing candidate or silently replace accepted fixtures.

**N22 PASS** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, Pending-mask capture and delayed trap control. Round 6: ADD-AC. Evidence: 6510dtvcore.c:1758 copies global_pending_int before DO_INTERRUPT at :1763; the macro uses local ik at :356 and tests IK_TRAP at :408. R12 now says the first boundary whose pending-mask copy contains the trap, and D1 explicitly tests a trigger during an already-dispatched interrupt after capture with the actual later callback clock. Rationale: A pending IRQ at trigger and a trap raised after its dispatch mask was captured are different histories. The handler can execute its first opcode before the next sample; the plan no longer forces an earlier mock callback. Required outcome: Bind the delayed-mask history to real both-host context and reject any later write clock under literal R12.

**N23 PASS** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, Reconciled budget and bounded terminal result. Round 6: ADD-AC. Evidence: D1 now canonically uses C+W unless it lies inside the autostart prelude, then measured prelude length+W. After load,0 and exactly W compared cycles/2W half-cycles the run must terminate by the limit or a gate quit within the recorded overshoot allowance; permit count, retained tail and exit reason are required. Waiting on an unsupplied permit, early stop or stretched window is rejected. Rationale: This closes the inconsistent D1/D5 wording and makes the low-clock outcome finite and observable without requiring a new protocol or pretending limitcycles stops mid-instruction. Required outcome: Keep the same low-clock mock/real controls and record the terminal reason and predetermined allowance per host.

**N24 ADD-AC** (medium), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:81, D2/D5 OrdinaryDiscovery_ExcludedShimMetadataDoesNotResolveLibraries. New finding. Evidence: ViceFactAttribute and ViceTheoryAttribute query ViceNative.IsAvailable during construction. The permitted comparator-only diagnostic run reached/JIT-compiled ViceNative.FindLibraryPath, although the selected comparator body does not use ViceNative; discovery-jit.log records that path. This is path-resolution evidence, not proof of a loaded DLL. Rationale: The plan has deliberate attempt controls and an empty ordinary audit gate, which will safely stop D4. Add a correct successful ordinary-discovery case so remediation cannot stop at detecting every inevitable legacy attribute probe. Required outcome: D2 owns mocks and D5 rechecks: ordinary discovery with excluded legacy attributes/providers resolves/loads none of the three libraries, keeps the managed fake selected and completes its denominator; deliberate native-attempt controls separately log/fail. Include FindLibraryPath/availability probes in the audit scope, not only NativeLibrary.Load.

**N25 ADD-AC** (low), docs/plans/PLAN-NATIVERESTORE-001.md:80, D1/D2/D5 FailedWriter_RecordsAbsentCandidateHonestly. New finding. Evidence: Pinned c64-snapshot.c:92-94 and vic20-snapshot.c:91-93 close and remove a newly created snapshot on a module write fai"}
